name: Emotional Intelligence
excerpt: Emotional Intelligence involves managing emotions and social interactions effectively.
notes: Emotional Intelligence (EI) or Emotional Quotient (EQ) can be developed over time with intentional effort. It consists of personal competence, including self-awareness and self-management, and social competence, including social awareness and relationship management.
context_summary:
- Involves managing emotions effectively
- Involves managing social interactions effectively
- Can be developed over time
- Consists of personal competence
- Includes self-awareness
- Includes self-management
- Consists of social competence
- Includes social awareness
- Includes relationship management
